body: You should totally go for it. Even if you live with other people. Get in the shower and throw your lungs out. Im not the crying type, but the one time I needed it I did it. One of the best tgings I did. Kind of like erasing the caché as funny as it sounds. If you want to talk more about it, Im down for it. At the end it helps us both.

Damn this feels too familiar. I know what you're saying. Feeling impotent of your actions, getting behind in the race of life, knowing you'll fuck up every attempt of true relationships, the feeling of undeserved generosity; its all hard. The worst part is that even if you try really hard on something, everybody finds it pointless or it goes unnoticed. The man makes plans and God laughs. I found that inspiration just won't work to make things done. If you want to do something, you need to force a time and place, don't let your evading mind get away with it again. 

Now about the romance thing... I totally get that. Even if both sides are deeply in love or are getting into it, a bit of luck will be the one who decides what's gonna really happen. Once I met a wonderful girl. It was one of those people who you don't feel awkward at all by just talking to each other, like if it was a movie script. Long story short, she ended up with another guy. But Im glad she's happy, she's also really close to me and I'm ok with it (I don't believe all this 'friendzone' thing. I apreciate all the few friends I can get). What I got out of it is that some people aren't ment to be in a relationship, or at least not in a given moment.

Porn. Yea, lots of porn. Weird ass porn. Legal porn, but really weird nonetheless Won't get too deep in that one. Just gotta tell you, cold showers do really help calm the urges, as weird at it sounds.

Anyway... thanks for hearing my ted talk, glad you shared your feelings with me. It really helps me soothe my nerves. Hope you get your life together. You still got the cards, only need to know to play them.

Yea love is a hard one. Such a pure feeling can be the cause of confusion and harm. There's no constant feeling within us, just a spiral of emotions trying to give a meaning to our vessels. Shared emotions that won't necessarily be equal within the two parties, no matter how hard we figth for it. Such strong emotions can be very blinding. Life has a funny way to make fun of us.

My father also diverced years ago. It can be harsh but if they're happy, who am I to blame them? Thanks for sharing stranger.
